title: HistCAD: Constraint-Aware Parametric CAD Histories for Evaluating Editability
abstract: arXiv:2602.19171v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Sketch constraints specify geometric conditions for constructing and modifying parametric CAD models. We study whether predicted constraints allow a given history to reproduce the required initial model and support prescribed dimensional edits. We introduce HistCAD, an executable representation and dataset whose Academic and Industrial collections contain 180,495 parametric construction histories with entity-referenced sketch constraints and retained feature operations. Predictors receive these histories with the geometry and feature definitions retained and explicit sketch constraints removed. They generate constraints for every sketch without seeing the edit request. The benchmark compares models built with alternative constraint sets for the same history under the same dimensional edit. translated_title: HistCAD：用于评估可编辑性的约束感知参数化CAD历史
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.19171v4 公告类型： replace-cross 摘要：草图约束规定了构建和修改参数化CAD模型的几何条件。我们研究预测出的约束能否让给定的构建历史重现所需的初始模型，并支持规定的尺寸编辑。我们提出了HistCAD，这是一种可执行的表示形式和数据集，其学术（Academic）与工业（Industrial）两个集合共包含180,495条参数化构建历史，这些历史带有引用实体的草图约束并保留了特征操作。预测器接收这些保留了几何形状与特征定义、但显式草图约束已被移除的历史，并在看不到编辑请求的情况下为每个草图生成约束。该基准测试在相同的尺寸编辑条件下，比较针对同一历史采用不同约束集所构建的模型。当模型能够重现所需的初始几何、达到目标尺寸值、并保留指定的关系与未编辑（区域）……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: HistCAD提出了一个包含180,495条参数化CAD构建历史的可执行表示与数据集基准，用于评估预测的草图约束能否使模型重现所需初始几何并成功完成规定的尺寸编辑。
en_tdlr: HistCAD introduces an executable representation and dataset of 180,495 parametric CAD construction histories to benchmark whether predicted sketch constraints can reproduce the required initial model and support prescribed dimensional edits.
